key.name: mind-toggle
key.description: Keyboard shortcut to show or hide the Mind chat panel. Change with: gsettings set org.gnome.shell.extensions.mind mind-toggle "['<Super>b']"

key.name: system-prompt
key.description: Instruction prepended to every conversation as the system role. Empty string disables it. Changes take effect immediately without restarting the daemon.

key.name: nudge-enabled
key.description: Allow the assistant to initiate messages after a period of idle time.

key.name: nudge-idle-minutes
key.description: How many minutes of silence before the assistant may send a proactive message. Minimum 1, maximum 480.
